content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

The challenge of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-which-architecture-actually-11|COREMERCH guide to selling]] digital products without Stripe or similar platforms lies not only in the unavailability of these services but also in their restrictive policies. For instance, a PayPal account suspension can tie up funds for up to 180 days, leaving creators in precarious positions. This scenario calls for a reliable alternative infrastructure that is not subject to the same limitations. Sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to establish their online stores with complete ownership and autonomy, avoiding the pitfalls of traditional platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a combination of free and open-source tools that facilitate digital sales without third-party dependencies. Hosting is managed through platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be achieved with services like Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery is streamlined using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and payment processing is executed via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee. This architecture ensures that creators maintain full control and ownership of their operations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. Individuals selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products can benefit from a system that enables them to process payments seamlessly and autonomously. By leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can bypass the limitations imposed by platforms like Stripe and PayPal, allowing them to focus on their work rather than worrying about payment processing issues.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures full ownership of your online store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of sovereign commerce infrastructure lies in its carefully chosen components that work in harmony. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide the hosting environment, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets serve as databases for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handle file delivery. NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain payment verification, allowing creators to receive funds without the need for traditional banking systems. Each component plays a crucial role in creating a seamless and efficient online selling experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by setting up a free hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For order storage, choose Supabase or Google Sheets, and select Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution, deployed in just 48 hours, ensuring your online store is fully operational and tested before handoff.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can still sell digital products using sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach leverages free tools and services that enable you to create a fully operational online store with cryptocurrency payment processing. By using platforms like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you can establish a reliable and autonomous selling experience.
Bypassing traditional platforms opens new markets for digital creators.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
